name: Speaking with Gan'zulah
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
<The head of Gan'zulah speaks.>

Curse you!  And curse your ancestors!!

Only blood and revenge can cool my rage, so if that is your wish, then... do this:

Throw yourself into the heart of the Skullsplitters to the east.  Slay the fiercest among them, and if you survive...then break yourself against their chief, Ana'thek the Cruel.  Hah!  Bring me his shattered armor if you can!

May he tear off your limbs and leave you to rot and be eaten by carrion.
narrative.objectives:
Kill 8 Skullsplitter Hunters, 6 Skullsplitter Headhunters, and 4 Skullsplitter Berserkers.

Bring the Broken Armor of Ana'thek to the Bubbling Cauldron at the Grom'gol Base Camp.
narrative.offerRewardText:
I do not want to believe it, but I cannot deny what you have done. And my rage eases, now that Ana'thek is defeated.

Your might will drive you to great deeds, adventurer. But one day...I will see you in the Nether and we will again match strength.

I will be waiting.
narrative.requestItemsText:
Although my own flesh boils off my skull, I can still smell your fear.

Hah!  You will never complete my task...
